prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized formal hierarchical faction pennant — a religious/military
order. Flat app-icon geometry. A rectangular banner with a swallowtail
fly mounted on a simple vertical pole. The banner is a bold saturated
palette primary color. Centered on the banner, a formal sigil: a
simple clean cross shape, or a circled diamond, in a contrasting
palette color. Crisp and hierarchical, not rebellious.
formatted_prompt: Flat bold app icon centered on an off-white canvas with generous padding. A rectangular swallowtail pennant mounted on a slim vertical black pole, rendered in pure flat vector geometry with sharp crisp edges. The banner field is vivid red (#FF0000) with a centered formal white cross shape as the sigil, rendered as a clean flat secondary-color fill. The swallowtail notch is a precise geometric cut. No gradients, no textures, no brushwork, no ink strokes. Bold color separation: red banner, white cross, black pole. Every shape readable at 16px. Modern UI icon register, Phosphor Fill aesthetic, 2026-era app icon design.
